kjv: and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree
mine: and have shown me future generations
note: ur'itani ketor ha'adam hamma'alah is one of the most obscure phrases in Chronicles: "you have seen me like the turn of the man of ascent". The parallel 2 Sam 7:19 reads "this is the instruction (torah) for mankind". Every rendering is a guess.
